season: Matthews Community Farmers\' Market is the largest, most diverse producer-only farmers\' market in the greater Charlotte area. All market products, except fish, are grown, raised or made within 50 miles of Matthews.​ Fish is caught on the NC coast and brought to market by the fisherman. You\'ll find freshly harvested produce, naturally-raised meats, local honey, plants, artisan foods and hand-crafted items as well as food trucks, live music, chef demonstrations, special events and giveaways. MCFM is a registered non profit 501(c)3. MCFM proudly accepts SNAP/EBT and match dollars up to $50!

Uptown Farmers Market is celebrating its sixth spring season in 2025, having grown from 20 vendors in 2020 to over 60 in 2025. In 2025, the Market has launched a new initiative for children in Radish Roots Corner, providing $4 in tokens to spend on fruits and vegetables, inspiring a new generation to good health! Every week the Market hosts cooking demos, children\'s activities, musicians, food trucks, and a variety of seasonal activities.

The market footprint shifts to the parking lot section in front of the mural and tightens up to form a cozy and vibrant gathering spot during the chillier months. With only two hours to shop, the Market stays busy with patrons excited to buy fresh produce during the Winter months and still access all of their favorite artisan vendors.
